purpose: Characterize the unchanged application's natural Mandarin-English speech baseline before proposing a quality change.
helper_reuse_condition: All Native product source, managed SDK adapter, model lock and pinned inference dependencies still match this previously accepted build; the later menu icon change does not affect inference.

data.name: ASCEND
data.authors: Lovenia et al., LREC 2022, HKUST CAiRE
data.selection: Every row of the original test metadata in metadata order; no output-dependent selection, omission, reordering, or repeated inference.
data.invalid_or_missing_input: Fail dataset preparation and preserve diagnostics; do not silently skip the row.
data.path_handling: Historical paths are metadata only; resolve unique archive members inside the private dataset directory.
data.input_audio: Require valid 16000 Hz mono PCM16 WAV, verify duration and SHA for every selected input, keep original bytes.
data.secondary_cross_check: Compare the first 300 test IDs and references with the pinned public benchmark only to validate metadata order; still evaluate the entire original test split.

scoring.source: HLTCHKUST/ASCEND utils.py tokenize_for_mer/tokenize_for_cer and eval.py at the pinned author revision
scoring.normalization: Remove the exact author CHARS_TO_IGNORE set and lowercase both reference and hypothesis. Keep all other characters, fillers and repetitions. No traditional-to-simplified conversion, NFKC, digit expansion, entity rewriting or spelling correction.
scoring.tokenizer: jieba 0.42.1; strip empty jieba tokens; retain ASCII tokens intact and split non-ASCII tokens into characters, matching the author function.
scoring.mixed_error_rate: Sum Levenshtein edit distances divided by sum reference mixed tokens; this is not jiwer.mer match-error-rate.
scoring.character_error_rate: Sum Levenshtein edit distances on non-whitespace normalized characters divided by sum reference characters.
scoring.script_presence_limit: Absence of a reference script is a triage indicator, not automatic proof of semantic omission, translation or pronunciation failure.

acceptance_boundary.candidate_promotion: Retain existing fixed-corpus and per-case non-regression requirements; investigate lexical/numeric equivalence without rewriting historical raw scores.
